guarantees.claim: unused_a_y_q is continuously assigned to a_y_q.
unused_b_y_q is continuously assigned to b_y_q.
Block gen_pre_dom_indep is instantiated only when parameter PreDomIndep is 1'b1.

assumptions.claim: The y shares a_y_q and b_y_q must have been individually blinded with z0 and the per-domain sums properly formed before this chunk (i.e., before the register bank), as described in the comments.
assumptions.risk: First-order domain separation breaks; side-channel leakage possible.

uncertain_points.claim: Signals unused_a_y_q and unused_b_y_q are assigned but are not read in this chunk; their consumption elsewhere is unknown.
uncertain_points.risk: If truly dead, no functional impact; if meant to be connected, missing connection can break masking.

uncertain_points.claim: Comment states the optimization is suitable only for first-order masking, but no RTL or parameter check enforces this; higher-order use would be insecure.
uncertain_points.cond: if module used with higher-order parameters
uncertain_points.risk: Insufficient masking against higher-order SCA, leading to key extraction.
